Candidate participant counts: the explicitly separate final HC, AN, and MD groups contain 37, 26, and 26 girls. For a three-group critical ANOVA, 37 + 26 + 26 = 89 participants; for AN versus MD, 26 + 26 = 52; for HC versus AN or HC versus MD, 37 + 26 = 63. These are conditional candidate analytic sums, not selected row N values. Medication sensitivity exclusions were nine AN and seven MD participants, but the paper reports findings based on the whole sample. No N was inferred from degrees of freedom. Original fields only were assigned. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. PDF pages 4–6 rendered and visually inspected; canonical text is the evidence source. No effect-size conversions performed.
